# ⚡ PRP Framework Speed Run

For when you just want to start FAST. Copy, fill, and go:

---

```markdown
Build [PROJECT NAME] - [one line description]

MVP Features:
1. [Core feature]
2. [Second feature] 
3. [Third feature]

Tech: [Next.js 15 / React / FastAPI] + [TypeScript / Python] + [PostgreSQL / MongoDB]
UI: [shadcn/ui / MUI / Tailwind]
External: [Jira / Slack / None] via [OAuth / API key]
Scale: [10 / 100 / 1000] users
Timeline: [ASAP / 1 month]

Similar to: [existing product] but [key difference]

Give me:
1. CLAUDE.md based on CLAUDE-NEXTJS-15.md patterns
2. Planning PRP command
3. Implementation PRP command  
4. Required ai_docs files
5. GO! 🚀
```

## 🎪 Hackathon Mode

For 24-48 hour builds:

```markdown
Hackathon build: [PROJECT] - [description]

Must have in 24h:
1. [Feature 1]
2. [Feature 2]  
3. [Demo-ready UI]

Tech: Whatever's fastest
Skip: Tests, docs, nice-to-haves

GO GO GO! 🏃‍♂️
```

Command: `/hackathon-prp-parallel [project description]`

---

## 🔥 Pro Tips for Speed

1. **Use "recommend best"** for tech choices
2. **Skip comprehensive PRD** if you know what you want
3. **Run parallel PRPs** for independent features
4. **Use devcontainer** for autonomous execution
5. **Start with working code**, refine later

Remember: You can always add more context later. Start building! 🚀
